title: 腳踏車
question: 公共腳踏車的計費方式如下：騎乘未滿半小時，以半小時計算。

test_case.note: 5(半小時)+7*10(四小時之內有7個半小時)+1*20(八小時內有1個半小時) = 95。

en.title: Bike Rental
en.question: Bike rental prices are below. Less than half an hour counts as half an hour.

test_case.note: 5 (first half hour) + 7*10 (7 half hours up to 4 hours) + 1*20 (1 half hour up to 8 hours) = 95.
